description: A PHYSICAL LINK BREAK from a node with no physical link to us is answered with PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM anyway, so that node stops repeating it.
note: No link exists. At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10), a type 8 D_PDU carrying PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 0 (octet 40), C_PDU ID 0: perhaps our earlier confirm was lost. The reading of B-0323 answers it with PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM (octet 50) in a type 8 D_PDU, and nothing else changes: no link_state output, since there is no link (B-0425). At 3000 the burst ends with the prediction ahead and the confirm queued: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and contention, 45000 ms; the confirm goes out at 52000, our C_PDU ID 0. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15: contention waits 45000 ms (K-0080).
